Reuse the returned preview_digest when applying reviewed selections. memory_tool_descriptions.mnemos_forget_related: Apply a reviewed related-forget preview using the unchanged preview_digest and matching preview_limit. A committed target-only deletion is not complete related-copy erasure. Even zero retained preview records does not prove semantic erasure.
